This small island is
miles off the coast
of Asia Minor in the Aegean Sea. Being rocky and infested with snakes, lizards and
scorpions, it had little commercial value, so it was used by the Roman Empire for a
colony where were housed the more desperate criminals, political prisoners, etc_

tribulation. It was at this time that the early church was going through great persecutions_

imprisoned and killed. John, like multitudes of others
